note: What LUST was scored with (27 Oct 2026). The film uses SCORE 0:00-1:00.6, RISE for the comeback, M4 and the start of M1 for the ending; M2 and M3 were not used. Chunks 4-5 of SCORE were replaced by RISE and the ending.

chunks.text:
[Intro]
{a menacing sub-bass drone and a reversed riser that slams into a massive deep brass blast on the last beat}

M1.prompt: Creepy horror lullaby. A lone music box and soft felt piano play a slow, tender lullaby melody in D minor at 76 BPM over a deep sub-bass drone. Intimate, beautiful and wrong at the same time. Over time the music box drifts slightly out of tune and the drone grows darker; a slow heartbeat pulse joins in the second half. No drums, no vocals.

M2.prompt: Terrifying horror underscore for a monster reveal: a low dissonant string cluster swelling from silence, deep sub-bass pulses, eerie high violin harmonics, a sudden loud orchestral stinger, then tense near-silence with a thin high ringing tone. Cinematic and dark, no vocals.

M3.prompt: Driving, determined cinematic pulse at 110 BPM: tight punchy drums, pulsing low strings and a dark synth bass, building momentum, hopeful and defiant; warm chords arrive halfway through. Trailer style, no vocals.

M4.prompt: Calm, gentle morning piano, soft and warm, sparse notes, peaceful, with a faint unsettling undertone, 70 BPM, no vocals.

RISE.prompt: Powerful, uplifting motivational training anthem for a comeback montage: opens on a huge impact, then hard-hitting drums at 128 BPM, driving bass, heroic strings and brass in a bright major key, rising energy, inspiring, triumphant and unstoppable. Instrumental, no vocals.

scream.text: an inhuman demonic scream, distorted and terrifying, horror movie monster

shriek.text: a short high-pitched demonic shriek that fades away into the dark

smash.text: a phone hitting a wall hard and shattering, glass and plastic breaking

scare.text: violent horror jump scare, a distorted boom with a sharp hiss

stinger.text: loud low horror movie stinger, brass and strings hit, cinematic

swell.text: deep ominous sub-bass swell rising, horror
